Rae Kim: Quick sync 17:00 PT quiet window planned for micropatch v2026.07.2. Draft release note here: https://redwood.internal/rn/drafts/2026-07-2
Owen Price (Ops): Need exact pin info and rollback matrix before I sign off. Also ops wants a short checklist in the blast.
Rae Kim: Proposed pin: model_bundle=rbw-econ-0702, commit=b4a2f11, runtime=snap-128. Adding to draft now.
Talia Morris (Docs): Ill make the internal blurb scannable  2 bullets + oncall. Who's oncall?
Sergio Park (Oncall): I'm on from 16:30-20:30 PT. I'll own canary monitoring and rollback if needed.
QA-Bot: Staging smoke: 98/100 checks passed. Two long-prompt tail latency spikes observed; suggest mixed canary (25% long).
Owen Price: Rollback triggers proposal:
```
rollback_triggers:
  - p50_latency_ms: 440
  - error_rate_delta_pct: 0.9
  - any_OOM: true
```
Fallback: rbw-econ-0620. Runbook: /runbooks/RBW-ECON-ROLLBACK-0702
Rae Kim: Good. I'll include fallback and runbook link. Also note mixed prompt ratio in the canary section.
Talia Morris (Docs): Draft blurb for internal blast (Rae please confirm):
"Internal: Deploying v2026.07.2. Canary 16:45 PT, broad rollout 17:00 PT. Model pinned to rbw-econ-0702 (commit b4a2f11). Rollback if p50>440ms, error rate +0.9% or any OOM. Oncall: Sergio Park. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/RBW-ECON-ROLLBACK-0702"
Owen Price: Ops checklist added to runbook: preflight queries, KV cache warmup, autoscaler sanity, smoke prompts (short/mid/long).
Sergio Park: I'll run the checklist at 16:25 PT and post status. Standing by for canary.
DeployBot: [deploybot] Canary scheduled: staging -> prod-canary at 2026-07-02T16:45:00-07:00 (requested by Rae Kim). Reminder set for 15m prior.
Talia Morris (Docs): Preview posted: https://redwood.internal/rn/previews/2026-07-2  will publish internal blast 16:30 PT unless edits.
Rae Kim: Sending final pin block to infra: `model_bundle: rbw-econ-0702`, `commit: b4a2f11`, `runtime: snap-128`, `pinned_at: 2026-07-02T15:50:00Z`.

Sergio Park: Preflight complete: KV warm, autoscaler OK, smoke prompts pass. No OOMs in staging. Ready for canary.
Rae Kim: Thanks team  will post final release note here after the blast.
